available(bytes32).details: Check if a name is available for registration.

params.label: The hash of the label to check.

params.ensAddr: The address of the ENS registry.
params.node: The node (namehash) that this registrar administers.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

ownerOf(bytes32).details: Get the owner of a name. Returns address(0) if the name is expired.

reclaim(bytes32,address).details: Reclaim ownership of a name in ENS, if you own it in the registrar. Similar to BaseRegistrarImplementation's reclaim function.

params.label: The hash of the label to reclaim.
params.owner: The address to set as the owner in ENS.

reclaimRootNode().details: Allows the owner to reclaim ownership of the root node in ENS, if needed.

params.duration: Duration in seconds for the registration.
params.label: The hash of the label to register.
params.owner: The address of the new owner.

registered(bytes32).details: Check if a name is registered and not expired.

params.label: The hash of the label to check.

params.duration: Duration in seconds to extend the registration.
params.label: The hash of the label to renew.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setResolver(address).details: Allows the owner to set the resolver for the root node.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

userdoc.notice: A registrar that allocates subdomains to the first person to claim them, with expiration functionality similar to BaseRegistrarImplementation.
